Design grew materially; re-plan from scratch/design.md in full. New: items 21-24 split launching into a machine launcher that knows nothing of experiments and an experiment launcher (the pass) above it, remove cohorts, and put limits on jobs/machines and on the experiment only. Item 20 is withdrawn. Keep the work already in the tree. Update PR #113 in place. No release, no rental.
